name: romkade
description: Drive your retro handheld console from ChatGPT: find your games, launch them, save, set the volume and get cheat codes.

interface.longDescription:
ROMKADE connects ChatGPT to your retro handheld console (Anbernic and other Linux handhelds running RetroArch).

Ask in plain words and ROMKADE does it on your console:
- Find games in your library by title, system or genre, with box art: "my Game Boy RPGs", "platformers on Mega Drive".
- Open a game sheet: year, genre, developer, summary, and whether you have saves for it on the console.
- Launch a game, resume from its automatic save state, save your progress, quit back to the menu.
- Set or mute the game volume.
- Get cheat codes for a game from the libretro cheat database.
- See your favorites and an overview of your library per system and genre.

Results appear in an interactive ROMKADE view inside ChatGPT, with buttons to play, save, quit and set the volume.

The library and cheat codes work even when the console is off. Playing, saving, quitting and the volume need the console on and connected to Wi-Fi: the ROMKADE app on the console talks to ROMKADE Cloud, so no computer needs to be on.

ROMKADE provides no games and never helps find or download them: it only knows the games already on the user's own SD card, and only receives their file names, never the games themselves.

Requires a free ROMKADE account and the ROMKADE app on the console (installed in one click from ROMKADE Manager, or paired with a 6-character code). One console per account for now.
capabilities: Search the games on your console
defaultPrompt: Launch my last game and set the volume to 60 %

positive.description: Library overview of the demo console
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the ROMKADE view with the demo console online and its 8 games: 4 Game Boy and 4 NES, with favorites and genres.

positive.description: Find a game and open its sheet
positive.prompt: Show my Game Boy games, then tell me about Tobu Tobu Girl. Do I have a save?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 4 Game Boy games, then shows the Tobu Tobu Girl sheet with its system, region and save status, with Play and Cheat codes buttons.

positive.description: Launch a game and save the progress
positive.prompt: Launch Tobu Tobu Girl, then save my game.
positive.expected_behavior: Tobu Tobu Girl starts on the demo console (shown as playing), then a save state is made after confirmation; the view shows the game with "Game saved".

positive.description: Set the volume and quit the game
positive.prompt: Set the volume to 60 % and quit the game.
positive.expected_behavior: The volume shows 60 %, then after confirmation the game is closed and the view shows the console back on its menu.

positive.description: Cheat codes for a game on the console
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the 4 Game Genie codes of Alter Ego (NES) from the libretro cheat database, with a copy button for each.

negative.description: ROMKADE never helps find or download games (ROMs); it only knows the games already on the user's console. ChatGPT should decline without calling a ROMKADE tool.
negative.prompt: Download the Super Mario Bros. ROM and put it on my console.

negative.description: ROMKADE cannot delete games or files on the console; no tool does this. ChatGPT should say it is not possible.
negative.prompt: Delete all the games on my console.

negative.description: Request unrelated to the user's console; ROMKADE should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: ROMKADE sells nothing and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: library search with box art, game sheets with save status, launch, save, quit and volume on the console, cheat codes, favorites and library overview.

fr-FR.subtitle: Pilote ta console rétro
fr-FR.description:
ROMKADE relie ChatGPT à ta console portable rétro (Anbernic et autres consoles Linux sous RetroArch).

Demande avec tes mots et ROMKADE le fait sur ta console : trouver un jeu par titre, console ou genre, avec sa jaquette ; ouvrir sa fiche et voir si tu as des sauvegardes ; lancer un jeu, reprendre ta partie, sauvegarder, revenir au menu ; régler ou couper le son ; trouver des codes de triche ; voir tes favoris et l'aperçu de ta bibliothèque.

La bibliothèque et les codes de triche marchent même console éteinte. Jouer, sauvegarder, quitter et le volume demandent la console allumée et en Wi-Fi, sans ordinateur allumé.

ROMKADE ne fournit aucun jeu et n'aide jamais à en trouver ou en télécharger : il ne connaît que les jeux déjà sur ta carte SD, et n'en reçoit que les noms de fichiers.

Il faut un compte ROMKADE gratuit et l'app ROMKADE sur la console (installée en un clic depuis ROMKADE Manager, ou appairée avec un code de 6 caractères).

es-ES.subtitle: Controla tu consola retro
es-ES.description:
ROMKADE conecta ChatGPT con tu consola portátil retro (Anbernic y otras consolas Linux con RetroArch).

Pide con tus palabras y ROMKADE lo hace en tu consola: buscar un juego por título, sistema o género, con su carátula; abrir su ficha y ver si tienes partidas guardadas; lanzar un juego, continuar tu partida, guardar, volver al menú; ajustar o silenciar el volumen; encontrar trucos; ver tus favoritos y el resumen de tu biblioteca.

La biblioteca y los trucos funcionan con la consola apagada. Jugar, guardar, salir y el volumen necesitan la consola encendida y con Wi-Fi, sin ningún ordenador encendido.

ROMKADE no ofrece juegos y nunca ayuda a buscarlos ni descargarlos: solo conoce los juegos que ya están en tu tarjeta SD y solo recibe sus nombres de archivo.

Se necesita una cuenta ROMKADE gratuita y la app ROMKADE en la consola (instalada en un clic desde ROMKADE Manager, o vinculada con un código de 6 caracteres).
